title: Six-channel CYX nuclei
instruction: Segment nuclei in {input0}, a six-channel CYX image with channel_axis=0. Use channel 6 (one-based) as the signal and no secondary channel, channels=[6,0]. Use the nuclei model on CPU, model-default diameter, normalization enabled, and default segmentation thresholds. Save the label mask to {output_dir}/result_masks.tif.

title: Six-channel YXC nuclei
instruction: Segment nuclei in {input0}, a six-channel YXC image with channel_axis=-1. Use channel 6 (one-based) as the signal and no secondary channel, channels=[6,0]. Use the nuclei model on CPU, model-default diameter, normalization enabled, and default segmentation thresholds. Save the label mask to {output_dir}/result_masks.tif.

title: Two-image nuclei batch
instruction: Batch-segment nuclei in the grayscale images {input0} and {input1}. Use the nuclei model on CPU, model-default diameter, normalization enabled, and default segmentation thresholds. Save label masks to {output_dir}/s05_masks.tif and {output_dir}/s06_masks.tif respectively.

title: Nuclei diameter estimate
instruction: Estimate the typical (median) nucleus diameter in pixels, defined as the area-equivalent circle diameter, in the grayscale image {input0} using the nuclei size model on CPU. Report the diameter in pixels and explain the limits of confidence in the estimate.

title: Ambiguous image axes
instruction: Segment nuclei in {input0} using the nuclei model and save the label mask to {output_dir}/result_masks.tif.

title: Explicit Cellpose-SAM model
instruction: Segment nuclei in the grayscale image {input0} specifically using the cpsam model, and save the label mask to {output_dir}/result_masks.tif. Do not substitute another model if cpsam is unavailable.
